summary: Verified iteration-7 features across backend and frontend. All 5 backend endpoints and 4 frontend flows pass. Magazzino ricalcola giacenze, Upload pulisci duplicati, Dashboard ordini modal (Media Ordini/Giorno + Ordini Totali, NO Picco), Dashboard clienti modal (Clienti in Crescita, NO Piu Frequenti), Forecast PDF with anno_recente/val_recente/anno_precedente/val_precedente all working.

issues: Hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping <tr> inside <tbody> (cosmetic; carried over from previous iteration)

critical_code_review_comments: recompute_all_quantities() in backend/routes/prodotti.py loops N products with per-product find() to db.vendite and db.ordini (potential N+1). For 100+ products with large vendite/ordini this can be slow. Consider aggregation pipeline with $group on prodotto_nome for both collections.

In /pulisci-duplicati the sort key `sorted(dup['ids'], key=lambda x: str(x))` stringifies ObjectId which is close but not identical to natural ObjectId ordering; works because ObjectId string repr is monotonic-ish but relying on lexicographic sort could fail across differing generation clocks. Prefer sorting by ObjectId natively.
Dashboard card-detail 'clienti' clienti_in_crescita loops all customers in Python; consider $lookup or two aggregations with client-side diff kept as is (fine for current dataset).
Forecast export-pdf reads `stats.get('num_mesi_dati',0)` but forecast/generate never sets that key inside statistiche -> KPI 'X mesi dati' will always show 0 in the PDF (minor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-7 features validated. Backend base URL from frontend/.env. Dashboard KPI cards are blurred; open detail modals by clicking StatCard icon (data-testid=stat-card-icon) - order: 0=Fatturato, 1=Ordini, 2=Clienti, 3=Alert. New testids: recalculate-btn (Magazzino), pulisci-duplicati-btn (Upload), ordini-media-giornaliera, ordini-totali, clienti-in-crescita, ordini-scontrino-medio, card-detail-modal.
